limitations: Static review only. The revised fixture detaches the reference query before NumPy conversion, resolving the previous blocker. No fixture execution results were supplied.

The four query derivatives and centered Fisher Gram agree with the supplied routing formulas. The JVP fixture checks them in FP64. During FP32 training, routing_metric recomputes attention normalization in FP64, so its weights can differ from the native forward by rounding.

The optimizer applies the damped inverse square root to the decay-separated AdamW displacement and matches each query row’s norm before FP32 storage. The fixture checks one cloned update per mode. The factory hook preserves the original AdamW arguments when a plugin omits make_optimizer.
